{{Quote|One of these smugglers is my mark. I think. I'm not sure. I've been tracking him for some time and just now caught up with him here in this city.|[[Tearfin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
'''Himfan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|To be honest, I'm a little confused. I know the smuggler captain and I can trust him. But everyone else just blames each other, and I don't know what to do.|Tearfin, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Himfan was present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], visiting several [[City/Legends|cities]] on the planet. At the same time, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Tearfin]] traveled to the planet. The bounty hunter was seeking a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who stole a crate of valuable equipment. As the crate had a [[transponder]], she easily traced her mark to Tatooine. However, the thief found the transponder and turned it off not long after Tearfin arrived on the planet. The bounty hunter then located Himfan and a group of smugglers, suspecting one of them of being her mark, but she was not able to identify the thief. Besides the smuggler captain, the group included five other smugglers, namely [[Parugga]], [[Rh'klin]], [[Barosk]], [[Klaphini]] and [[D'lonis]]. Among them, Tearfin only knew Captain Himfan and she was convinced that she could trust him. The bounty hunter interrogated Himfan and the other smugglers, but could not determine who was innocent or guilty, basically because all of the smugglers simply blamed each other. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] seeking to [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|become]] a [[Hero of Tatooine]] eventually came along to help Tearfin. After interrogating all the smugglers, the spacer finally identified the thief and confirmed that the smuggler captain was not the culprit. The spacer later informed Tearfin and was awarded the [[Mark of Intellect]] for the successful investigation.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FileTemplateSmuggler.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Himfan]]
Himfan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Himfan spawned under the generic "smuggler" template, the appearance of this NPC was randomized under one of eight possible depictions. Although his gender and appearance were randomized during each server reset, he systematically appeared as a Human and quest dialogues identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG" />

Himfan was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> This NPC periodically spawned in random cities across Tatooine, along with Tearfin and the five other smugglers. Players taking part in the "Intellect" segment of the "Hero of Tatooine" had to interrogate Himfan and the other smugglers to determine which one was Tearfin's mark. The identity of the culprit varied among the six smugglers but Himfan each time the quest was reset.<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 24|Publish 24]]," on [[October 18]], [[2005]], Himfan and the five other smugglers were given proper names<ref name="SWG-2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> to replace randomly generated names.<ref name="SWG" />

The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]]<ref name="SWG-2005" /> but the "Intellect" segment was not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
